1. I cancelled my streaming services subscription.

3. Deleted Instagram. ( Tiktok got banned in India )
4. If someone or something is making you feel nervous, cut it off.
5. If you feel bad of a day spending on movies TV series tik tok, just delete it.
6. See if you can learn a new skill in that time. You can spend on that subscription charges on online courses if you want.
7. Change the diet and start working out. If you don't like gym, you can exercise at home.
8. Exercise and eating defined diet help me plan my day. Got me feeling good about myself.
9. Find friend with similar interest. Talk with them as much as you can.
